functionalRequirement: User shall/will be able to open various types of accounts like savings, fixed deposit, etc.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support opening at least 5 different types of bank accounts with all standard required fields for each account type.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive coverage of account types mentioned in the functional requirement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must implement multi-factor authentication for account creation, including government-issued ID verification and biometric or two-factor authentication.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects against fraudulent account openings and ensures secure account creation process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide real-time validation for all account opening fields, with clear error messages for incorrect or incomplete information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users complete account creation process accurately and efficiently.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The account opening system must have 99.99% uptime during business hours (8 AM to 8 PM, 7 days a week).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can open accounts consistently without service interruptions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The entire account creation process must be completed within 10 minutes, with each validation step taking no more than 2 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a quick and responsive account opening experience for users.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to add expenses with details including amount, date, payer, and optional split among participants.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately calculate expense splits with 100% mathematical precision, supporting up to 10 participants per expense.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures accurate financial calculations for expense tracking.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Expense entry and split calculation must be completed within 500 milliseconds for single entries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides responsive expense tracking with minimal user waiting time.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All expense data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 encryption and transmitted using TLS 1.3 protocol.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive financial information from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The system must provide inline tooltips and auto-complete suggestions for common expense categories and payer names.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Simplifies expense entry process and reduces user input errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must implement automatic backup of expense data every 5 minutes and support full data restoration within 15 minutes in case of system failure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures no loss of critical financial tracking information.

functionalRequirement: Faculties shall be able to upload and download assignments, college notices, student notices, journals, and videos.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: File uploads and downloads must complete within 30 seconds for files up to 500 MB, with bandwidth support of at least 10 Mbps.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures efficient handling of various document and media types.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: The system must support file uploads and downloads for at least 20 different file formats including .docx, .pdf, .jpg, .mp4, .xlsx, and .ppt.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides flexibility for different types of academic documents and media.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement role-based access control ensuring only authorized faculty members can upload or download specific types of documents.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive academic materials from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Provide file type and size validation with clear error messages, preventing uploads of unsupported or oversized files.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guides users to upload appropriate files and prevents system overload.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain 99.95% uptime for document management system during academic working hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures consistent access to critical academic resources.

functionalRequirement: System shall allow users to rate and review services by providing comments on tour plans or services, with comments stored in the database and a thank you message displayed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: Support rating system with 5-star scale and ability to submit text comments of up to 500 characters.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides comprehensive feedback mechanism for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: Implement content filtering to prevent offensive or inappropriate comments before database storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures clean and appropriate user-generated content.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Comment submission and thank you message display must occur within 200 milliseconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides immediate feedback to enhance user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: Provide optional fields for detailed feedback and suggestions to improve services.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Encourages more comprehensive user input and service improvement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: Implement automatic backup of all user reviews and ratings every hour, with ability to restore within 10 minutes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures preservation of valuable user feedback data.
